description: This file defines the class `MappableOutboundSignal`, which represents an outbound signal that can be mapped with a specific payload mapping. It groups signals with targets sharing the same payload mapping and provides methods for JSON serialization, equality checking, and accessing related data.

classes.name: MappableOutboundSignal
classes.description: A final class representing an outbound signal with an associated payload mapping, capable of JSON serialization and equality comparison.

methods.name: MappableOutboundSignal
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the signal with a source, targets, and payload mapping, verifying non-null values and matching payload mappings.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns the payload mapping associated with this signal.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of target objects.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the signal to a JSON object using a specified schema version and predicate.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on delegate and payload mapping.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on delegate and payload mapping.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including delegate and payload mapping details.
